title: Negative numbers
summary: Negative integers on the number line, adding and subtracting, multiplying and dividing, order of operations, substituting and the four quadrants.

cards.title: Introduction to negative integers
cards.rule: Numbers get smaller as you move left on the number line.
lines: A lift at floor 2 goes down 5 floors: floor **−3**

cards.title: Adding and subtracting positives
cards.rule: Adding moves right. Subtracting moves left.
lines: A diver at −12 m rises 5 m: **−7 m**

cards.title: Adding and subtracting negatives
cards.rule: Adding a negative means subtract. Subtracting a negative means add.

cards.title: Multiplying and dividing
cards.rule: Same signs give a positive. Different signs give a negative.
lines: Lose 3 points in each of 4 rounds: \(-3 \times 4 = -12\)
cards.tip: this rule is for × and ÷ only: \(-3 + (-2) = -5\).

cards.title: Order of operations
cards.rule: Brackets, then × and ÷, then + and −, from left to right.
cards.note: Do the multiplying and dividing before the adding and subtracting.

cards.title: Substituting integers
cards.rule: Put negative numbers in brackets when you substitute.

cards.title: The Cartesian plane
cards.rule: Four quadrants, numbered anticlockwise from the top right. \((x, y)\): across, then up or down.
cards.note: \((-2, 0)\) is on the x-axis, so it isn't in any quadrant.
